items.title: Hyliion's founder turned an EV downturn into an energy power play
items.summary: Hyliion founder and CEO Thomas Healy took his EV truck company public, watched the industry collapse, and rebuilt it into a power generation business that bought a division from GE and works with the United States Navy. He joins host Elizabeth Gore to talk about the pivot, the coming AI-fueled energy crisis, using 3D printers to build a new kind of power plant, and more.
